installed_sdk.rationale: This S4 slice makes existing graph-owned ProcessorNode parameters reachable through the host timeline binding and graph modulation routes. It adds no installed SDK header, target, or exported catalog entry.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No offline Timeline MCP tool definition, schema, or handler changes.

live_product_control.rationale: No live Product-A control operation, broker grant, profile policy, or executor catalog changes.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No design-time capability manifest or agent catalog entry is added by this host interoperability slice.
